items.summary_en: A Juejin post works through a question that interviewers now ask: given that candidates are assumed to use AI, why should a company still hire you when AI already writes most of the code? The author contrasts this with interviews from two years ago, which still tested hand-written Promises and React Fiber internals, and argues the evaluation criteria have shifted. Useful for developers preparing for technical interviews right now.

items.title: AI教AI开车！百度首次披露Apollo World世界模型，让无人驾驶突破“不可能三角”
items.summary_zh: 11 月 3 日深圳百度 AI Day·Apollo 专场上，百度 Apollo 首次披露 Apollo World，一个面向物理 AI 的智能体驱动全模态世界模型，并提出因果性、交互性两项门槛加三项增益属性的「2+3」判断标准。它把虚拟场景里的交通参与者建模为可决策、可交互的 AI 智能体，已用于萝卜快跑全球化测试与验证；官方称其一天可跑十万公里虚拟路测，约等于真实路测车带安全员跑三年。做自动驾驶仿真和物理 AI 的人值得看它如何定义世界模型的评价尺度。
items.summary_en: At its Baidu AI Day Apollo event in Shenzhen on November 3, Baidu Apollo unveiled Apollo World, an agent-driven omni-modal world model for physical AI, along with a "2+3" rubric: causality and interactivity as baseline requirements, plus three capability metrics. The model treats every traffic participant in a virtual scene as a decision-making, interacting AI agent, and is already used to test and validate Baidu's robotaxi service across global markets; Baidu claims it can simulate 100,000 km of virtual road testing per day, roughly three years of real-world testing with a safety driver. Relevant to anyone working on autonomous-driving simulation or physical AI.

items.title: 构建面向 Agentic 推理的下一代 LLM 推理引擎
items.summary_zh: TokenSpeed 是尚旭春在 AICon 2026 深圳站分享的 Agent 场景推理引擎：优化目标从“打满 batch”改为“每用户 TPS 不低于 70 的延迟约束下最大化单卡吞吐”，batch=1 时端到端延迟比 TensorRT-LLM 快 9%。分享还覆盖分层解耦架构、自动并行编译与 KV Cache 复用路线，面向为 coding agent 多轮短请求调优推理栈的工程师。
items.summary_en: TokenSpeed, presented by independent contributor Shang Xuchun at AICon 2026 Shenzhen, is an inference engine built for agentic workloads: rather than maximizing batch throughput, it targets the highest per-GPU throughput that still keeps each user above 70 TPS. On that basis it reports 9% lower end-to-end latency than TensorRT-LLM at batch size 1. The talk also covers a decoupled architecture, auto-parallel compilation and KV Cache reuse — useful for anyone tuning inference for multi-turn coding agents.

items.summary_zh: 作者记录了自己从 Cursor 转向 Codex 大半个月的真实体验：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 给他的感觉更像一个能自主推进任务的超级 Agent，而不只是编程助手。适合正在挑选 AI 编程工具、犹豫要不要更换工作流的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: The author writes up roughly half a month of using Codex after switching from Cursor: Cursor was what first made AI-assisted coding feel striking, while Codex comes across as a full agent that pushes tasks forward on its own rather than just a coding assistant. Aimed at developers weighing which AI coding tool to adopt, or whether switching workflows is worth it.

items.title: [NAS] 群晖 NAS 被勒索后从 SSD 缓存恢复文件
items.summary_zh: 一位用户的群晖 NAS 在出差期间被勒索病毒加密，常规办法都无效后，他想起机器里有两块用作缓存的 SSD，于是让 AI 遍历缓存生成 CSV 目录清单，发现重要文件基本都在，目前正在提取数百 GB 数据。他强调重要文件仍需云端单向冷备份，3-2-1 备份原则不能省。
items.summary_en: After ransomware encrypted the files on his Synology NAS while he was travelling, a user recovered data from the two SSDs he had installed as cache. Having AI generate a CSV directory listing of the cache showed that most important files were still there, and he is now extracting hundreds of gigabytes. He still stresses off-site cold backups and the 3-2-1 rule.

items.title: [iPhone] 有没有人遇到过 iPhone 无线充电时候音效消失的情况？
items.summary_zh: 有 V2EX 用户反馈，他的 iPhone 18 Pro 放到无线充电器上时，本该出现的圆环动画和「duang」提示音会消失，重启手机能暂时恢复，但过一段时间又复发。从 iOS 27.2 Beta 升到 27.2 正式版、再到 27.3 Beta 都没解决，网上重开静音模式之类的办法也无效。他在帖中求教成因和一劳永逸的解法。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user reports that on their iPhone 18 Pro, the ring animation and "duang" chime that normally fire when the phone is placed on a wireless charger have stopped appearing. A reboot brings the sound back temporarily before it vanishes again, and the issue has persisted across iOS 27.2 beta, the 27.2 release and 27.3 beta; common workarounds like toggling silent mode did nothing. The poster is asking for the cause and a permanent fix.

items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
items.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
items.author: NVIDIA
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 开源了 Auto Ontology（Apache-2.0），一个用 Python 编写的库，可从企业元数据生成本体、打通跨系统的指标口径，并搭建 AI 就绪的知识图谱。它给 agent 提供指标、实体与关系的业务含义，用认证定义和血缘校验生成的查询并附带来源，再通过 MCP、CLI 和 API 暴露给任意 agent 框架，适合在意 agentic analytics 结果准确性的团队。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA's Auto Ontology is an open-source Python library (Apache-2.0) that builds a semantic, graph-based context layer from enterprise metadata: it generates ontologies, reconciles conflicting metric definitions across systems and produces AI-ready knowledge graphs. Agents get grounding for metrics and entities, query validation against certified definitions and lineage, plus provenance, with context served to any agent harness via MCP, CLI or API. Aimed at teams where a fast but wrong agent answer is worse than none.

items.title: [分享创造] 全新三端纯原生 SSH 客户端： SSH、SFTP 与 AI 尽在一个应用里，随楼依次赠送 100 位评论者 50 个$v2ex
items.summary_zh: SSHYard 是一款免费开源的 SSH/SFTP 客户端，同时内置 AI 助手，可以在终端里管理远程文件，并让 AI 直接在主机上执行命令，一个窗口完成。它支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，用 Go 编写、纯原生渲染，不依赖 WebView；源码在 GitHub 的 Licoy/sshyard，作者在帖中按楼层送出 50 $v2ex，共 100 层。
items.summary_en: SSHYard is a free, open-source SSH/SFTP client with a built-in AI assistant that can run commands directly on the remote host, so terminal sessions and file management stay in one window. It runs on macOS, Windows and Linux, is written in Go with fully native rendering and no WebView, which the author credits for its speed and low footprint. Source lives at GitHub's Licoy/sshyard; the V2EX thread hands out 50 $v2ex per floor for 100 floors.

items.title: [阅读] 2026 年九月 读人工智能，护眼 3 本
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇 2026 年 9 月的读书笔记，作者读了梅拉妮·米歇尔的《AI 3.0》（豆瓣 8.8）、第三版《人工智能》教材和《大国护眼之策》三本。他的判断是 2023 年前的书都没覆盖大模型，但书中从感知机、反向传播到 ConvNets 和 AlphaGo 的算法脉络仍有助于理解 LLM 的来路，剩下更多是数据、算力和工程问题。
items.summary_en: A September 2026 reading note covering three books: Melanie Mitchell's AI 3.0, a third-edition AI textbook and a Chinese title on eye care. The author argues anything published before 2023 misses large language models, yet these two AI books still map the lineage from perceptrons and backpropagation through ConvNets to AlphaGo, which helps explain where LLMs came from. The rest, he says, is data, compute and engineering work that only production environments can surface.

items.title: Uber 总裁跳槽 OpenAI！曾掌舵谷歌、Snap 公关，Brockman 亲自发文欢迎
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 11 月 3 日宣布，Uber 总裁兼首席公司事务官 Jill Hazelbaker 将于 12 月初出任 OpenAI 同一职位，直接向联合创始人 Greg Brockman 汇报，统管全球传播、企业声誉与品牌定位。她在 Uber 任职十余年、今年 5 月刚升任总裁，此前在 Google、Snap 与政治传播领域任职。该岗位自前首席传播官 Hannah Wong 今年 1 月离职后已空缺约十个月，正值 OpenAI 应对监管与公众信任压力之际。
items.summary_en: OpenAI said on November 3 that Uber president and chief corporate affairs officer Jill Hazelbaker will join in early December in the same role, reporting directly to co-founder Greg Brockman and owning global communications, corporate reputation and brand positioning. She spent over a decade at Uber, was promoted to president in May, and previously held senior roles at Google and Snap plus political communications work. items.title: 同一个模型从 30 分到 95 分：拉开差距的不是模型，是Harness
items.summary_zh: YC Paper Club 的 Harness Night 上，Prime Agent 作者 Seth Karten、OpenJarvis 作者 Jon Saad-Falcon 与 QM 团队讨论了一个现象：同一份模型权重，换一套 Harness，ARC-AGI 成绩能从 30% 升到 95%。Karten 把上下文分为模型权重、活跃上下文加 REPL、文件系统状态三层，主张压缩、Python REPL、编程式子 Agent 等能力缺一不可；Saad-Falcon 则称本地 LLM 只落后前沿模型 6 到 12 个月。
items.summary_en: At YC Paper Club's Harness Night, Seth Karten (Prime Agent), Jon Saad-Falcon (OpenJarvis) and the QM team argued the harness matters as much as the model: the same weights can score anywhere from 30% to 95% on ARC-AGI depending on the scaffolding around them. Karten splits context into model weights, active context plus a REPL, and filesystem state, and calls compression, a Python REPL and programmatic sub-agents non-negotiable. Saad-Falcon notes local LLMs trail frontier models by only 6 to 12 months.

items.title: Linux内核也能造了？Codex 11天写出13.9万行新内核，Rocky Linux 10跑起来了
items.summary_zh: CentOS 创始人之一、Rocky Linux 发起人 Gregory Kurtzer 在 2026 年 10 月 27 日宣布，用 11 天、以“人类主导的智能体工程”写出约 13.9 万行代码，做出以 Rust 为主的 x86-64 内核 Ginux，可启动 Rocky Linux 10 并运行 systemd。它不是 Linux 的分叉，但实现了 Linux ABI，未修改的二进制程序可直接运行。其参照对象是 Anthropic 的 Nicholas Carlini 用 16 个 Claude 智能体从零造 C 编译器的实验。
items.summary_en: Gregory Kurtzer, a CentOS co-founder and the driving force behind Rocky Linux, said on October 27, 2026 that in 11 days of what he calls Human-Directed Agentic Engineering he produced roughly 139,000 lines of code for Ginux, a standalone Rust-centric x86-64 kernel that boots Rocky Linux 10 and runs systemd. It is not a Linux fork, but it implements the Linux ABI, so unmodified binaries run on it. He cites Nicholas Carlini's 16-agent Claude C compiler as precedent.

items.title: 手机到底有没有偷听我们？我抓包了 72 小时，抓到了真凶
items.description: 麦克风硬件音频采集唤醒为 0 次；真正实现未卜先知的，是 公网 NAT 时空超图（ST-GNN）、现代隐私集合求交（PSI） 与 端侧微模型特征向量化（On-Device Em
items.summary_zh: 作者连续抓包 72 小时，发现麦克风硬件采集唤醒次数为 0，没有拿到手机偷听的证据；真正造成“未卜先知”的，是公网 NAT 时空超图（ST-GNN）、现代隐私集合求交（PSI）和端侧微模型特征向量化。适合关心隐私边界和推荐系统原理的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: A developer captured 72 hours of phone traffic and found zero microphone wake-ups at the hardware level, which weakens the "my phone is listening" theory. The uncanny precognition instead traces to public NAT spatio-temporal hypergraphs (ST-GNN), modern private set intersection (PSI), and on-device micro-model feature vectorization. Useful for engineers who want to understand how targeting actually works and where the privacy line sits.

items.title: The 'Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen' post is misleading

items.summary_en: A Hacker News submission argues that the circulating claim "Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen" is misleading, because the experiments that read raw weights and the ones that actually fix Qwen use completely different techniques. It's a useful caution for anyone tracking weight-editing or model-surgery claims: placing two results side by side can imply a causal link that isn't there.

items.summary_zh: 作者手上只有甲方给的一张卫星截图，用 Three.js 加 Blender 还原出一座 3D 综合能源补给站：从截图反求设计稿相机、脚本化建模、Cycles 烘焙夜景，到重卡倒车入位动画与运营仿真，最后叠图逐像素比对还原度。适合做 Web 3D 可视化、数字孪生，或需要从参考图逆向搭建场景的前端开发者参考。

Useful for front-end developers working on Web 3D visualization, digital twins, or reconstructing scenes from reference imagery.
